verdict.rationale: Event-triggered rules are a fair question for a package manager, since lifecycle hooks or pre/post-install scripts are plausible, so the axis applies. The pack shows no uv feature for user-defined rules that fire actions on events. `tool.uv.cache-keys` only invalidates cached builds when files or commits change, which is an adjacent control. The `setup-uv` GitHub Action is a host-platform integration, not a uv capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
